verdicts.observation: The source says "most of our forces are outside", but the target 「我们的部队却还在外面」 drops "most" and reads as if the whole army is outside. The next line in kruk-invasion.lua:25 says "Only you and few others are left", so some forces clearly stayed behind. Suggest 「正当我们大部分部队都在外面的时候」.

Runtime risk: physical.lua:320 formats this string with tformat(eff.power). The target's 「降低 50%。」 has a lone % followed by a full-width character, which is not a valid conversion, so Lua 5.1 string.format raises invalid option and the effect description breaks. Separately, the source string only says "%d%% chances to encase your foes in iceblocks". The added 「造成伤害时」, 「3 回合」 and 「冰块吸收的伤害降低 50%」 have no support in this long_desc. Remove the unsupported additions, or escape it as %% and cite source evidence for them.

The source "Fires a bolt of lightning" (other.lua:1230) describes a single-target bolt, but the target translates it as 「闪电球」. In ToME, bolt and ball are distinct mechanics: a ball is an area attack. 「球」 would mislead players into expecting an area effect. Suggest 「闪电箭」 or 「一道闪电」.

The talent name "Electricity" (physics.lua:61, steamtech/physics) means electricity or electrical power. The target 「电子」 means "electron", which is a wrong meaning. The envelope freezes no terminology entry supporting this rendering. Suggest 「电力」 or 「电能」.

The source (explosive.lua:238, SAW_SHELL "Saw Shell") is "A special shot that slices 'n' dices.", which describes cutting and chopping. The target 「附带链锯的特殊弹头」 invents a chainsaw that the source never mentions and loses the slicing meaning. A saw blade is not a chainsaw, and 链锯 is reserved in this project for steamsaw. Suggest something like 「一种能切能剁的特殊弹药」.
